Validate: Conformance checks. [`json_schema_is_valid`](#json_schema_is_valid) returns TRUE/FALSE and [`json_schema_errors`](#json_schema_errors) lists each failure (both new in the DuckDB 2.0 build). [`json_schema_validate`](#json_schema_validate) and [`json_schema_validate_schema`](#json_schema_validate_schema) return TRUE on success and raise on failure; on the Haybarn 1.5 build wrap them with COALESCE(TRY(...), false) when a boolean filter is required.
Enrich: Default-value handling. [`json_schema_patch`](#json_schema_patch) computes the [JSON Patch (RFC 6902)](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6902) needed to fill missing `default`s; [`json_schema_update`](#json_schema_update) applies it inline.
